children: Overview
Germany cybersecurity provider's preliminary H1 revenue rose 11% yr/yr to EUR 4.9 mln
Preliminary EBITDA positive but declined due to planned investments and prior-year one-time effects
Company confirmed 2026 outlook for higher revenue and positive EBITDA
Outlook
Cyan expects 2026 revenue between EUR 10.2 mln and EUR 11.5 mln
Company anticipates 2026 EBITDA to be positive but below 2025 level due to investments
Cyan says high recurring revenue and investments support its 2026 outlook
Result Drivers
END-CUSTOMER GROWTH - Co said a 30% increase in end-customer base drove revenue growth
RECURRING REVENUE - Co maintained recurring revenue at 96%, providing stability
PLANNED INVESTMENTS - EBITDA declined due to planned investments in cybersecurity solutions, sales, and market development
